forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَسۡتُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُواْ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡۗ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغۡيَٰنࣰ ا وَكُفۡرࣰ اۖ فَلَا تَأۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: Say, "O People of the Scripture, you are [standing] on nothing until you uphold [the law of] the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to you from your Lord." And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord will surely increase many of them in transgression and disbelief. So do not grieve over the disbelieving people.
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O People of the Book! You have nothing to stand on unless you observe the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to you from your Lord.” And your Lord’s revelation to you ˹O Prophet˺ will only cause many of them to increase in wickedness and disbelief. So do not grieve for the people who disbelieve

forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنࣰ اۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۖ فَلَا تَذۡهَبۡ نَفۡسُكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَسَرَٰتٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَصۡنَعُونَ
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do.
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: Are those whose evil-doing is made so appealing to them that they deem it good ˹like those who are rightly guided˺? ˹It is˺ certainly Allah ˹Who˺ leaves to stray whoever He wills, and guides whoever He wills. So do not grieve yourself to death over them ˹O Prophet˺. Surely Allah is All-Knowing of what they do

forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعࣱ نَّفۡسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ إِن لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: Now, perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their denial, if they ˹continue to˺ disbelieve in this message

forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعࣱ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their disbelief

forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبۡيَضَّتۡ عَيۡنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلۡحُزۡنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمࣱ‏
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: He turned away from them, lamenting, “Alas, poor Joseph!” And his eyes turned white out of the grief he suppressed

forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ تَفۡتَؤُاْ تَذۡكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوۡ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡهَٰلِكِينَ
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: They said, "By Allah, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish."
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: They said, “By Allah! You will not cease to remember Joseph until you lose your health or ˹even˺ your life.”

forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشۡكُواْ بَثِّي وَحُزۡنِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know.
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: He replied, “I complain of my anguish and sorrow only to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know

forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: يَٰبَنِيَّ ٱذۡهَبُواْ فَتَحَسَّسُواْ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَاْيۡـَٔسُواْ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَاْيۡـَٔسُ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people."
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: O my sons! Go and search ˹diligently˺ for Joseph and his brother. And do not lose hope in the mercy of Allah, for no one loses hope in Allah’s mercy except those with no faith.”

forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.arabic: وَلَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا مَآ أَتَوۡكَ لِتَحۡمِلَهُمۡ قُلۡتَ لَآ أَجِدُ مَآ أَحۡمِلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَلَّواْ وَّأَعۡيُنُهُمۡ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمۡعِ حَزَنًا أَلَّا يَجِدُواْ مَا يُنفِقُونَ
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.saheeh: Nor [is there blame] upon those who, when they came to you that you might give them mounts, you said, "I can find nothing for you to ride upon." They turned back while their eyes overflowed with tears out of grief that they could not find something to spend [for the cause of Allah].
forbidden-or-praised-sorrow.khattab: Nor ˹is there any blame on˺ those who came to you ˹O Prophet˺ for mounts, then when you said, “I can find no mounts for you,” they left with eyes overflowing with tears out of grief that they had nothing to contribute

hands-sent-forward.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
hands-sent-forward.saheeh: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
hands-sent-forward.khattab: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”

hands-sent-forward.saheeh: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
hands-sent-forward.khattab: They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”

hands-sent-forward.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلۡتَنظُرۡ نَفۡسࣱ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ لِغَدࣲۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
hands-sent-forward.saheeh: O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
hands-sent-forward.khattab: O believers! Be mindful of Allah and let every soul look to what ˹deeds˺ it has sent forth for tomorrow. And fear Allah, ˹for˺ certainly Allah is All-Aware of what you do

hands-sent-forward.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُۚ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرࣰ اۖ وَإِن تَدۡعُهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهۡتَدُوٓاْ إِذًا أَبَدࣰ ا
hands-sent-forward.saheeh: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.
hands-sent-forward.khattab: And who does more wrong than those who, when reminded of their Lord’s revelations, turn away from them and forget what their own hands have done? We have certainly cast veils over their hearts—leaving them unable to comprehend this ˹Quran˺—and deafness in their ears. And if you ˹O Prophet˺ invite them to ˹true˺ guidance, they will never be ˹rightly˺ guided

hands-sent-forward.arabic: وَلَن يَتَمَنَّوۡهُ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
hands-sent-forward.saheeh: But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
hands-sent-forward.khattab: But they will never wish for that because of what their hands have done. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of the wrongdoers

hands-sent-forward.arabic: وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوۡنَهُۥٓ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
hands-sent-forward.saheeh: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
hands-sent-forward.khattab: But they will never wish for that because of what their hands have done. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of the wrongdoers

hands-sent-forward.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيۡسَ بِظَلَّامࣲ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
hands-sent-forward.saheeh: That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
hands-sent-forward.khattab: This is ˹the reward˺ for what your hands have done. And Allah is never unjust to ˹His˺ creation.”

hands-sent-forward.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيۡسَ بِظَلَّٰمࣲ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
hands-sent-forward.saheeh: "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
hands-sent-forward.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is ˹the reward˺ for what your hands have done. And Allah is never unjust to ˹His˺ creation.”

stated-causes.saheeh: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
stated-causes.khattab: Every soul will be detained for what it has done

stated-causes.saheeh: Except the companions of the right,
stated-causes.khattab: except the people of the right

stated-causes.saheeh: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
stated-causes.khattab: who will be in Gardens, asking one another

stated-causes.saheeh: About the criminals,
stated-causes.khattab: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺

stated-causes.saheeh: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
stated-causes.khattab: “What has landed you in Hell?”

stated-causes.saheeh: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
stated-causes.khattab: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed

stated-causes.saheeh: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
stated-causes.khattab: nor did we feed the poor

stated-causes.saheeh: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
stated-causes.khattab: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others

stated-causes.saheeh: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
stated-causes.khattab: and deny the Day of Judgment

stated-causes.saheeh: Until there came to us the certainty."
stated-causes.khattab: until the inevitable came to us.”

stated-causes.saheeh: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
stated-causes.khattab: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them

stated-causes.saheeh: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
stated-causes.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them

stated-causes.saheeh: Then into Hellfire drive him.
stated-causes.khattab: then burn them in Hell

stated-causes.arabic: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةࣲ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعࣰ ا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
stated-causes.saheeh: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
stated-causes.khattab: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long

stated-causes.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
stated-causes.saheeh: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
stated-causes.khattab: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest

stated-causes.saheeh: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
stated-causes.khattab: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor

stated-causes.saheeh: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
stated-causes.khattab: So this Day they will have no close friend here

stated-causes.saheeh: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
stated-causes.khattab: nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus

stated-causes.saheeh: None will eat it except the sinners.
stated-causes.khattab: which none will eat except the evildoers.”

stated-causes.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
stated-causes.saheeh: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
stated-causes.khattab: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”

stated-causes.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
stated-causes.saheeh: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
stated-causes.khattab: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”

stated-causes.saheeh: No! But you do not honor the orphan
stated-causes.khattab: Absolutely not! In fact, you are not ˹even˺ gracious to the orphan

stated-causes.saheeh: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
stated-causes.khattab: nor do you urge one another to feed the poor

stated-causes.arabic: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلࣰ ا لَّمࣰّ ا
stated-causes.saheeh: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
stated-causes.khattab: And you devour ˹others’˺ inheritance greedily

stated-causes.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبࣰّ ا جَمࣰّ ا
stated-causes.saheeh: And you love wealth with immense love.
stated-causes.khattab: and love wealth fervently

stated-causes.arabic: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكࣰّ ا دَكࣰّ ا
stated-causes.saheeh: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
stated-causes.khattab: Enough! When the earth is entirely crushed over and over

stated-causes.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفࣰّ ا صَفࣰّ ا
stated-causes.saheeh: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
stated-causes.khattab: and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank

stated-causes.arabic: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
stated-causes.saheeh: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
stated-causes.khattab: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then

stated-causes.saheeh: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
stated-causes.khattab: They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”

stated-causes.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ يَسۡعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۖ بُشۡرَىٰكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
stated-causes.saheeh: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
stated-causes.khattab: On that Day you will see believing men and women with their light shining ahead of them and on their right. ˹They will be told,˺ “Today you have good news of Gardens, under which rivers flow, ˹for you˺ to stay in forever. This is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.”

stated-causes.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقۡتَبِسۡ مِن نُّورِكُمۡ قِيلَ ٱرۡجِعُواْ وَرَآءَكُمۡ فَٱلۡتَمِسُواْ نُورࣰ اۖ فَضُرِبَ بَيۡنَهُم بِسُورࣲ لَّهُۥ بَابُۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلۡعَذَابُ
stated-causes.saheeh: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
stated-causes.khattab: On that Day hypocrite men and women will beg the believers, “Wait for us so that we may have some of your light.” It will be said ˹mockingly˺, “Go back ˹to the world˺ and seek a light ˹there˺!” Then a ˹separating˺ wall with a gate will be erected between them. On the near side will be grace and on the far side will be torment

stated-causes.arabic: يُنَادُونَهُمۡ أَلَمۡ نَكُن مَّعَكُمۡۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمۡ فَتَنتُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَتَرَبَّصۡتُمۡ وَٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡأَمَانِيُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡغَرُورُ
stated-causes.saheeh: The hypocrites will call to the believers, "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.
stated-causes.khattab: The tormented will cry out to those graced, “Were we not with you?” They will reply, “Yes ˹you were˺. But you chose to be tempted ˹by hypocrisy˺, ˹eagerly˺ awaited ˹our demise˺, doubted ˹the truth˺, and were deluded by false hopes until Allah’s decree ˹of your death˺ came to pass. And ˹so˺ the Chief Deceiver deceived you about Allah

stated-causes.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنكُمۡ فِدۡيَةࣱ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ مَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ هِيَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
stated-causes.saheeh: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination.
stated-causes.khattab: So Today no ransom will be accepted from you ˹hypocrites˺, nor from the disbelievers. Your home is the Fire—it is the ˹only˺ fitting place for you. What an evil destination!”

stated-causes.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتِي فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
stated-causes.saheeh: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
stated-causes.khattab: Not at all! My revelations had already come to you, but you rejected them, acted arrogantly, and were one of the disbelievers.”

stated-causes.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسۡوَدَّةٌۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوࣰ ى لِّلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
stated-causes.saheeh: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
stated-causes.khattab: On the Day of Judgment you will see those who lied about Allah with their faces gloomy. Is Hell not a ˹fitting˺ home for the arrogant

stated-causes.arabic: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ أَنۡ أَفِيضُواْ عَلَيۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ أَوۡ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
stated-causes.saheeh: And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever Allah has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allah has forbidden them both to the disbelievers."
stated-causes.khattab: The residents of the Fire will then cry out to the residents of Paradise, “Aid us with some water or any provision Allah has granted you.” They will reply, “Allah has forbidden both to the disbelievers

stated-causes.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ دِينَهُمۡ لَهۡوࣰ ا وَلَعِبࣰ ا وَغَرَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰهُمۡ كَمَا نَسُواْ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِهِمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَا كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
stated-causes.saheeh: Who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today We will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this Day of theirs and for having rejected Our verses.
stated-causes.khattab: those who took this faith ˹of Islam˺ as mere amusement and play and were deluded by ˹their˺ worldly life.” ˹Allah will say,˺ “Today We will ignore them just as they ignored the coming of this Day of theirs and for rejecting Our revelations.”

stated-causes.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
stated-causes.saheeh: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
stated-causes.khattab: And the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule

stated-causes.arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
stated-causes.saheeh: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
stated-causes.khattab: It will be said, “This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours! Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers

stated-causes.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوࣰ ا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
stated-causes.saheeh: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
stated-causes.khattab: This is because you made a mockery of Allah’s revelations, and were deluded by ˹your˺ worldly life.” So ˹from˺ that Day ˹on˺ they will not be taken out of the Fire, nor will they be allowed to appease ˹their Lord˺

stated-causes.saheeh: No! But you love the immediate
stated-causes.khattab: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world

stated-causes.saheeh: And leave the Hereafter.
stated-causes.khattab: and neglect the Hereafter

stated-causes.saheeh: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
stated-causes.khattab: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright

stated-causes.saheeh: Looking at their Lord.
stated-causes.khattab: looking at their Lord

stated-causes.saheeh: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
stated-causes.khattab: And ˹other˺ faces will be gloomy

stated-causes.saheeh: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
stated-causes.khattab: anticipating something devastating to befall them

stated-causes.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا ثَقِيلࣰ ا
stated-causes.saheeh: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
stated-causes.khattab: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them

stated-causes.saheeh: But you prefer the worldly life,
stated-causes.khattab: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world

stated-causes.saheeh: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
stated-causes.khattab: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting

stated-causes.saheeh: So as for he who transgressed
stated-causes.khattab: then as for those who transgressed

stated-causes.saheeh: And preferred the life of the world,
stated-causes.khattab: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

stated-causes.saheeh: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
stated-causes.khattab: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home

stated-causes.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ نَفۡسَكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلۡعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَهُۥۖ وَلَا تَعۡدُ عَيۡنَاكَ عَنۡهُمۡ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مَنۡ أَغۡفَلۡنَا قَلۡبَهُۥ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُهُۥ فُرُطࣰ ا
stated-causes.saheeh: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His countenance. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect.
stated-causes.khattab: And patiently stick with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His pleasure. Do not let your eyes look beyond them, desiring the luxuries of this worldly life. And do not obey those whose hearts We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who follow ˹only˺ their desires and whose state is ˹total˺ loss

stated-causes.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُلۡهِكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
stated-causes.saheeh: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.
stated-causes.khattab: O believers! Do not let your wealth or your children divert you from the remembrance of Allah. For whoever does so, it is they who are the ˹true˺ losers

stated-causes.saheeh: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
stated-causes.khattab: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺

stated-causes.saheeh: Until you visit the graveyards.
stated-causes.khattab: until you end up in ˹your˺ graves

stated-causes.saheeh: No! You are going to know.
stated-causes.khattab: But no! You will soon come to know

stated-causes.saheeh: Then no! You are going to know.
stated-causes.khattab: Again, no! You will soon come to know

stated-causes.saheeh: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
stated-causes.khattab: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺

stated-causes.saheeh: You will surely see the Hellfire.
stated-causes.khattab: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire

stated-causes.saheeh: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
stated-causes.khattab: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

stated-causes.saheeh: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
stated-causes.khattab: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures

stated-causes.arabic: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلࣱ مِّنكُمۡ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ قَالُواْ شَهِدۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِنَاۖ وَغَرَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَشَهِدُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ كَٰفِرِينَ
stated-causes.saheeh: "O company of jinn and mankind, did there not come to you messengers from among you, relating to you My verses and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "We bear witness against ourselves"; and the worldly life had deluded them, and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.
stated-causes.khattab: ˹Allah will ask,˺ “O assembly of jinn and humans! Did messengers not come from among you, proclaiming My revelations and warning you of the coming of this Day of yours?” They will say, “We confess against ourselves!” For they have been deluded by ˹their˺ worldly life. And they will testify against themselves that they were disbelievers

stated-causes.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
stated-causes.saheeh: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
stated-causes.khattab: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit

stated-causes.arabic: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدࣰ ا
stated-causes.saheeh: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever.
stated-causes.khattab: And he entered his property, while wronging his soul, saying, “I do not think this will ever perish

stated-causes.arabic: وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةࣰ وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهَا مُنقَلَبࣰ ا
stated-causes.saheeh: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."
stated-causes.khattab: nor do I think the Hour will ˹ever˺ come. And if in fact I am returned to my Lord, I will definitely get a far better outcome than ˹all˺ this.”

stated-causes.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
stated-causes.saheeh: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
stated-causes.khattab: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning

stated-causes.saheeh: Without making exception.
stated-causes.khattab: leaving no thought for Allah’s Will

stated-causes.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
stated-causes.saheeh: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
stated-causes.khattab: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept

stated-causes.saheeh: And it became as though reaped.
stated-causes.khattab: so it was reduced to ashes

stated-causes.saheeh: And they called one another at morning,
stated-causes.khattab: Then by daybreak they called out to each other

stated-causes.arabic: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
stated-causes.saheeh: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
stated-causes.khattab: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”

stated-causes.saheeh: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
stated-causes.khattab: So they went off, whispering to one another

stated-causes.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينࣱ‏
stated-causes.saheeh: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
stated-causes.khattab: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”

stated-causes.saheeh: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
stated-causes.khattab: And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose

stated-causes.saheeh: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
stated-causes.khattab: But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way

stated-causes.saheeh: Rather, we have been deprived."
stated-causes.khattab: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

stated-causes.arabic: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
stated-causes.saheeh: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "
stated-causes.khattab: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”

loss-and-taghabun.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡجَمۡعِۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحࣰ ا يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: ˹Consider˺ the Day He will gather you ˹all˺ for the Day of Gathering—that will be the Day of mutual loss and gain. So whoever believes in Allah and does good, He will absolve them of their sins and admit them into Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. That is the ultimate triumph

loss-and-taghabun.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: As for those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations, they will be the residents of the Fire, staying there forever. What an evil destination

loss-and-taghabun.arabic: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: Worship then whatever ˹gods˺ you want instead of Him.” Say, “The ˹true˺ losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on Judgment Day. That is indeed the clearest loss.”

loss-and-taghabun.arabic: وَتَرَىٰهُمۡ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرۡفٍ خَفِيࣲّۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِي عَذَابࣲ مُّقِيمࣲ‏
loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: And you will see them exposed to the Fire, fully humbled out of disgrace, stealing glances ˹at it˺. And the believers will say, “The ˹true˺ losers are those who have lost themselves and their families on Judgment Day.” The wrongdoers will certainly be in everlasting torment

loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Shall we inform you of who will lose the most deeds

loss-and-taghabun.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُونَ صُنۡعًا
loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: ˹They are˺ those whose efforts are in vain in this worldly life, while they think they are doing good!”

loss-and-taghabun.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَزۡنࣰ ا
loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: It is they who reject the signs of their Lord and their meeting with Him, rendering their deeds void, so We will not give their deeds any weight on Judgment Day

loss-and-taghabun.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance

loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state

loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: Even if we should be decayed bones?
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”

loss-and-taghabun.arabic: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذࣰ ا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةࣱ‏
loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”

loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast

loss-and-taghabun.saheeh: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
loss-and-taghabun.khattab: and at once they will be above ground
